documents.title: Соглашение между Правительством Турецкой Республики и Правительством СССР о разграничении континентального шельфа в Чёрном море
documents.publicationCitation: UNTS Vol. 1247, I-20344, pp. 137-146; authentic Russian and Turkish texts; entered into force 15 May 1981.
documents.notes: Article 1 directly lists the coordinate chain through 43°20′43″ N, 32°00′00″ E. The westward segment toward 43°26′59″ N, 31°20′48″ E is expressly left for later settlement and is therefore excluded from verified geometry. Article 2 states that the coordinates are in the coordinate systems of attached charts Nos. 500 (1977) and 501 (1976).

documents.title: Обмен нотами, составляющими соглашение о разграничении экономической зоны СССР и Турции в Чёрном море

date.note: The Soviet confirming note of 6 February 1987 completed the exchange and the agreement entered into force that day.

documents.publicationCitation: UNTS Vol. 1460, I-24690, pp. 135 ff.; entered into force 6 February 1987.
documents.notes: The Soviet Russian-language note explicitly confirms that the continental-shelf boundary established by the 23 June 1978 Agreement also constitutes the boundary of the Soviet and Turkish economic zones.
